arborea.finding: SAM P19690a is a complete short-stem specimen, not evidence for this model's long exposed stem. The primary study reports variable relative stem length and no clear correlation with frond size. Paired serial lateral branches, pods and fine unit divisions, a backing sheet and front/back differentiation support the selected form. The frozen brief explicitly defines a genus/species-level positive sculpture rather than a specimen replica; long smooth stalk, relief and overall size remain artistic. Two rows of32 and five simplified unit cues are the frozen simplification, not a universal fossil count. No roots or external fascicled tubes are added.
arborea.scope_verdict: pass within original transparent interpretive scope

swartpuntia.finding: The2024 primary restudy supports at least three equal-sized vanes,50–100 narrow modules per vane, a knobbly axis, more transverse proximal versus oblique distal modules, and no exterior stem. Fig13 includes GSN F423,F1886,F1887,F245; Fig14.1–2/F1888 and14.8 show basal vane continuity. Fig14.4 is Nasepia and14.5 the putative comparator, not target anatomy. The earlier inventory stalk wording is retained as historical planning and prospectively corrected before freeze. Three evenly spaced radial vanes are a declared3D interpretation, not a cast.

coronacollina.finding: In2015 Fig3, panelA is a reconstruction; panelB is holotype SAM P43257, a negative mold with rigid radial impressions. It is not a positive living-body photograph. The2012 description gives a truncated cone, smaller rim than base, shallow recess, threefold rim and ruler-straight spicules. Up to four attached spicules were reported; more are possible. The model's selected four-spicule positive sculpture is therefore bounded interpretation, not a universal count. Cone/spicule measurements satisfy the unchanged frozen ranges.2015 primary-author pixels are an explicit prefreeze substitute, not falsely credited as inspected2012 plates.
coronacollina.scope_verdict: pass with explicit primary-plate availability limitation

echmatocrinus.finding: ROM and1998 GSC25962 images support an elongated conical, irregularly plated animal with unbranched segmented arms and small alternating projections. Eight arms lies within the museum7–10 range. The1998 interpretation emphasizes thin irregular scales rather than thick rigid armor and proposes octocoral affinity without resolving the wider dispute. The model omits the Selkirkia substrate tube and any claimed mouth/anus or stereom. A shallow neutral cap is not identified as a mouth. The185mm museum value belongs to a cluster, not the chosen individual.
